question: How have getting around and spending time on your interests fitted into your week?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: I work mornings at the garden center and often draw storefronts after work. Getting around can feel uncomfortable when I feel singled out, like on Monday, but I waited at the same shelter on Wednesday without feeling watched. At home, it’s easier to concentrate on my sketchbook than at a busy stop.
